basic.name: Storm Bolt
basic.description:
Throw a hammer, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds

Quest: Basic Attack Heroes affected by Stuns, Slows, or Roots. Slowed or Rooted enemies grant 1 stack. Stunned enemies provide 2 stacks.  If the Hero dies within 3 seconds, gain 5 stacks.

Reward: Upon hitting 45 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds and restore 3 Mana.
Mythic Reward: Upon hitting 160 targets, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50%, width increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

basic.name: Thunder Clap
basic.description: Blast nearby enemies for 96~~0.04~~ damage and Slow them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 30% for the duration.

basic.name: Dwarf Toss
basic.description: Leap to target location, dealing 59~~0.04~~ damage to enemies on landing. Upon leaping, gain 30 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

heroic.name: Haymaker
heroic.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319~~0.04~~ damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319~~0.04~~ damage and knocking them aside.

trait.name: Second Wind
trait.description: Muradin restores 55~~0.04~~ Health per second when he has not taken damage for 4 seconds. When below 40% Health, increased to 111~~0.04~~ Health per second.

activable.name: Imposing Presence
activable.description:
Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

activable.name: Hardened Shield

level1.name: Dwarf Block
level1.description: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 3 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

level1.name: Third Wind

level4.name: Thunder Burn
level4.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second Thunder Clap explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 72~~0.04~~ damage.
